tools.name: service_status
tools.description: Whether the service is installed and running. [Offline only] Usage: service status [--name N]

args.description: The words and options after the command, one per element, as in the usage line.

tools.name: service_doctor
tools.description: Check the registration, the account and the directory permissions. [Offline only] Usage: service doctor [--name N]

args.description: The words and options after the command, one per element, as in the usage line.

tools.name: service_unit
tools.description: Print a hardened systemd unit that runs 'server run'. [Offline only] Usage: service unit [--name N] [--exec /path/to/dbdataproxy]

args.description: The words and options after the command, one per element, as in the usage line.

args.description: The words and options after the command, one per element, as in the usage line.

tools.name: cert_check
tools.description: Exit 1 when the certificate is missing or due for rotation. [Offline only] Usage: cert check

args.description: The words and options after the command, one per element, as in the usage line.

tools.name: config_check
tools.description: Validate the configuration (exit 0 valid, 2 invalid). [Offline only] Usage: config check [--file F]

args.description: The words and options after the command, one per element, as in the usage line.

tools.name: config_show
tools.description: The effective configuration with secrets masked; --origin adds where each value came from. [Offline only] Usage: config show [--origin] [--file F]

args.description: The words and options after the command, one per element, as in the usage line.

tools.name: health_check
